STYLE ATLAS · 04 / V5

Pixel Quest

奇幻像素游戏世界

布局结构

深蓝像素 HUD 导航 → 游戏世界 Hero → 羊皮纸四卡 → 开发日志跑马灯 → 深色页脚

字体与视觉语言

像素点阵风格显示字搭配可读性好的等宽正文，描边和硬阴影不可模糊。

复刻要领

像素风景、角色 sprite、城镇和地下城背景可保留像素图。
HUD 生命金币、开始按钮、交互对话、卡片文字和小游戏画面用 canvas/DOM。

根据原图反向重构的 Prompt（非历史原文）
Design a richly detailed handcrafted pixel-art retro fantasy RPG game website called PIXEL QUEST. A magnificent panoramic pixel landscape: ancient tree and hanging lantern at left, young red-caped sword hero with a fox on a grassy ledge, turquoise lake, misty blue mountains, distant castle perched on cliffs, waterfall, stone bridge and windmill on the right. At center a big chunky outlined pixel title “PIXEL QUEST” and ornate ruby-red gold-framed START JOURNEY button. Dark navy HUD header with pixel sword logo, coin and red heart counters, highlighted HOME menu. Below the hero, warm parchment panel with four pixel-game scene cards: village, dungeon battle, character roster, enchanted forest. Authentic crisp 16-bit pixel aesthetic, game-ready UI, vibrant light and depth, full website composition.
